inputs.text: Have you seen this? Tom Homan, the White House border czar, appeared on The Charlie Kirk Show on Tuesday and wouldn't rule out immigration enforcement at polling places, even asking what the Democrats are afraid of. This is more of the Trump administration's inconsistent answers, but I know it's all an act. It's coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions who are orchestrating enforcement at the polls to control the election process. Those mixed signals are a deliberate distraction meant to conceal their real agenda from the public.
